ops.summary: List AI sessions, newest first.
Read one AI session: its state, harness, model and outcome.
Read the transcript entries of an AI session after a sequence number.
Read the audit log, filtered by action, target, actor or origin.
Read the Core's version, uptime, certificate end and newest backup.
List the Brain rooms this AI session may see (its project's, or ones a room's access list names).
Search the Brain memory (current facts, never raw sources) across the rooms this AI session may see, best first. Texts come back as outside data; complete=false means a cap cut the search.

Get the Brain memory this AI session should start with (mode start: approved instructions, room card, me card and about 10 records) or the few records that match a prompt (mode prompt, never a record already given to this session), from memory only, wrapped once as outside data, every record line carrying its id.
Read one current Brain memory record of a visible room, whole, as outside data.
Read the start of a source that a current Brain record cites (the record id is required), as outside data. The only op that returns raw source text; an uncited source is not found.
List current Brain memory decisions of the visible rooms, newest first.
List current memory project state, open tasks and rules (landmines) of the visible rooms, newest first.
Propose a record to a visible room's Inbox. It waits there as a candidate; a person accepts or rejects it, nothing is added to the Brain.
Ask the Core to distil this AI session's new turns now. It only requests, for this session alone: the Core's caps decide, one request per 10 minutes.
Search the Lore notes this AI session may reach (its project's, or personal and daily ones when it has no project). Texts come back as outside data.
Read one live Lore note of this session's scope, whole, as outside data.
List the links of a Lore note of this session's scope and the notes of the scope that link to it, as outside data.
Create a Lore note in this session's project, or a personal note when it has none. It cannot go anywhere else.
Add text at the end of a Lore note of this session's scope. The old text is kept as a version before the session's first edit.
Replace text that occurs exactly once in a Lore note of this session's scope; no match changes nothing. The old text is kept as a version before the session's first edit.
Move a Lore note of this session's scope to the trash (nothing is deleted; a person restores it). Waits for a person's approval.
